title: find_port_53_pids ends with `printf '%s\n' "${pids[@]}"`; if inodes match no ow…
description:
find_port_53_pids ends with `printf '%s\n' "${pids[@]}"`; if inodes match no owning pid the array is empty and this relies on bash 4.4+ empty-array-under-set-u semantics. Correct on modern bash (the slim worker image ships it), but an explicit `[[ ${#pids[@]} -eq 0 ]] && return 0` guard before the printf would make it robust on any bash. Non-blocking, container-only path.
